title: Validating Multi-Model AI-Generated Acceptance Criteria in Requirements Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2611.32374v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in software engineering to generate artifacts such as requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, documentation, and code. Their use in requirements engineering raises important questions about correctness, traceability, and hallucination, especially because flawed specifications can affect later design, implementation, and verification activities. While much recent work on AI-assisted software engineering has focused on code generation and code-level validation, the validation of AI-generated specifications has received less attention. This paper addresses this gap by presenting a validation-oriented approach for AI-generated acceptance criteria. The approach combines retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), multi-model generation, and an explicitly structured human-in-the-loop workflow. translated_title: 验证需求工程中多模型AI生成的验收标准
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在软件工程中被越来越多地用于生成需求、用户故事、验收标准、文档和代码等制品。它们在需求工程中的应用引发了对正确性、可追溯性和幻觉问题的重要关注，尤其是因为有缺陷的规格说明会影响后续的设计、实现和验证活动。尽管近年来关于AI辅助软件工程的研究大多集中在代码生成和代码级验证上，但对AI生成的规格说明的验证却较少受到关注。本文通过提出一种面向验证的AI生成验收标准方法来填补这一空白。该方法结合了检索增强生成（RAG）、多模型生成以及明确结构化的人机协同工作流程。我们描述了一个可工作的原型系统，允许用户准备或输入用户故事并生成验收标准。
tldr: 本文提出一种结合检索增强生成、多模型生成与人机协同工作流的面向验证方法，用于解决需求工程中AI生成的验收标准缺乏有效性验证的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a validation-oriented approach combining retrieval-augmented generation, multi-model generation, and a structured human-in-the-loop workflow to validate AI-generated acceptance criteria in requirements engineering.
